class SelectedPhotoAccessDetector : Detector(), SourceCodeScanner, XmlScanner {

    override fun getApplicableUastTypes() = listOf(UCallExpression::class.java)

    override fun createUastHandler(context: JavaContext): UElementHandler {
        return object : UElementHandler() {
            override fun visitCallExpression(node: UCallExpression) {
                if (context.mainProject.targetSdk < ANDROID_14_TARGET_SDK) return
                if (node.methodName != "requestPermissions") return
                if (node.valueArguments.any { it.containsPhotoPermission(context) }) {
                    context.report(
                        ISSUE,
                        node,
                        context.getLocation(node),
                        "Consider handling partial photo/video access on Android 14+ instead of relying on the system selection lifecycle."
                    )
                }
            }
        }
    }

    override fun getApplicableElements(): Collection<String> = listOf(SdkConstants.TAG_USES_PERMISSION)

    override fun visitElement(context: XmlContext, element: Element) {
        if (context.mainProject.targetSdk < ANDROID_14_TARGET_SDK) return
        val permission = element.getAttributeNS(SdkConstants.ANDROID_URI, SdkConstants.ATTR_NAME)
        if (permission in PHOTO_PERMISSIONS) {
            context.report(
                ISSUE,
                element,
                context.getLocation(element),
                "Declaring $permission triggers the Android 14+ selected photo access dialog; consider adapting your app to handle partial access."
            )
        }
    }

    private fun UExpression?.containsPhotoPermission(context: JavaContext): Boolean {
        if (this == null) return false
        ConstantEvaluator.evaluateString(context, this, false)?.let {
            if (it in PHOTO_PERMISSIONS) return true
        }
        if (this is UCallExpression) {
            return valueArguments.any { it.containsPhotoPermission(context) }
        }
        return false
    }

    companion object {
        private const val ANDROID_14_TARGET_SDK = 34

        private val PHOTO_PERMISSIONS = setOf(
            "android.permission.READ_MEDIA_IMAGES",
            "android.permission.READ_MEDIA_VIDEO",
            "android.permission.READ_EXTERNAL_STORAGE"
        )

        @JvmField
        val ISSUE: Issue = Issue.create(
            id = "SelectedPhotoAccess",
            briefDescription = "Behavior change when requesting photo library access",
            explanation = """
                Selected Photo Access is a new ability for users to share partial access to their \
                photo library when apps request access to their device storage on Android 14+.

                Instead of letting the system manage the selection lifecycle, consider adapting \
                your app to handle partial access to the photo library, for example by using the \
                Photo Picker or persisting granted URIs.
            """.trimIndent(),
            category = Category.CORRECTNESS,
            priority = 5,
            severity = Severity.WARNING,
            implementation = Implementation(
                SelectedPhotoAccessDetector::class.java,
                EnumSet.of(Scope.JAVA_FILE, Scope.MANIFEST)
            ),
            moreInfo = "https://developer.android.com/about/versions/14/changes/partial-photo-video-access"
        )
    }
}
